# Feature: PDF Export for Circuit Analysis Reports

## 🎯 Objective
Add PDF export functionality to the existing advanced report generator system, enabling print-ready professional reports suitable for documentation and presentations.

## 📋 Background
The advanced report generator (Issue #7) successfully implemented interactive HTML reports with professional styling. PDF export was identified as a critical feature but deferred to maintain focus on core HTML functionality.

## 🛠️ Technical Requirements

### Dependencies to Add
```toml
weasyprint>=60.0    # HTML to PDF conversion
python-docx>=1.1.0  # Word documents (future)
```

### Implementation Tasks
- [ ] Add WeasyPrint integration to HTMLBuilder
- [ ] Create PDFBuilder class with proper CSS handling
- [ ] Optimize CSS for print media (page breaks, sizing)
- [ ] Add PDF export option to ReportGenerator.generate_report()
- [ ] Handle chart rendering for PDF (static images)
- [ ] Add comprehensive tests for PDF generation
- [ ] Update documentation and examples

### File Structure
```
src/circuit_sim/reports/builders/
├── html_builder.py     # Existing
├── pdf_builder.py      # New - PDF generation
└── base_builder.py     # New - shared functionality
```

## 📊 Success Criteria
- [ ] Generate PDF reports from existing HTML templates
- [ ] Maintain professional layout and formatting in PDF
- [ ] Charts render as static images in PDF
- [ ] Page breaks handled intelligently
- [ ] File size reasonable (<5MB for complex reports)
- [ ] Works across all report types (detailed, quick, executive)

## 🔗 Dependencies
- **Depends on**: Completed Issue #7 (Advanced Report Generator)
- **Blocks**: Complete report generation feature set

## 📚 Resources
- [WeasyPrint Documentation](https://weasyprint.org/)
- [CSS Print Media Guide](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_media_queries/Using_media_queries)
- [Plotly Static Image Export](https://plotly.com/python/static-image-export/)

## ⏱️ Estimated Effort
**Time**: 4-6 hours  
**Complexity**: Medium  
**Priority**: High (completes core feature set)

## 💡 Implementation Notes
- Leverage existing HTML templates and CSS
- Use print media queries for PDF-specific styling
- Convert interactive Plotly charts to static images
- Handle multi-page layouts gracefully
- Ensure consistent typography and spacing

## 🏷️ Labels
`enhancement` `priority-high`
